qa.title: Q1497 (Sep. 19, 2025)
qa.question: If I select a token for this spell, does it get removed from the game?
qa.answer:
No. It remains in your EX area after you put it there.

Follower and amulet tokens may exist in the EX area, field, and resolution zone. They are only removed from the game immediately after movement to other zones.

qa.title: Q1496 (Sep. 19, 2025)
qa.question: If I select an advanced follower such as VII. Oluon, Runaway Chariot with this spell, do I put that follower faceup on top of my evolve deck?
qa.answer:
No, you would put it into your EX area.

Advanced followers may exist in the evolve deck area, field, EX area, and resolution zone. If they are moved elsewhere, they are put back onto the top of the evolve deck faceup immediately afterward.

qa.title: Q1559 (Sep. 19, 2025)
qa.question: What does "Maneuver this card" mean?
qa.answer:
Maneuver is an ability that turns the card into a follower for that turn. Its attack and defense are listed on the card.

Similar to ordinary followers, a card that has been turned into a follower via Maneuver cannot attack on the turn it is put onto the field, unless it has Rush or Storm.

Cards that have been on the field for more than a turn can attack enemies as normal once Maneuvered.
